home.description: How {name} looks, books and gets paid.

profile.label: Business profile
profile.description: Name, photos, about, contact and social links.

locations.label: Locations
locations.description: Where you work: a shop, the client's place, or online.

booking.label: Booking rules
booking.description: Instant or approved bookings, notice, reminders.

payments.label: Payments
payments.description: Take deposits and card payments online.

forms.label: Client questions
forms.description: Intake forms clients fill in when they book.

link.label: Booking link
link.description: Your web address, QR code and going live.

verification.label: Verification
verification.description: Get the verified badge on your profile.

appearance.label: Page appearance
appearance.description: Header, colours, section order and link buttons.

profile.title: Business profile
profile.description: What clients see on your page and in search.
profile.toastLive: Changes are live on your page.

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: Your logo appears on cards and messages; the cover leads your page. Use your own work or space — not stock photos.
photos.logoHint: Square works best. Without one we show your initials.

basics.title: Basics
basics.taglineHint: One line under your name. {count, plural, one {# character left.} other {# characters left.}}
basics.taglinePlaceholder: e.g. Precision fades and beard work in Bed-Stuy
basics.categoryHint: Where you show up when people browse.

about.title: About
about.description: What you do, how you work, what makes a visit with you different. Plain words beat buzzwords.
about.label: About

contact.title: Contact & links
contact.description: Shown on your page. Clients can always message you through Kept, so these are optional.

social.hint: Type your handle or paste your profile link. To feature specific videos, posts or tracks on your page, add them in <link>Portfolio</link>.

errors.useProfile: Use the link to your {network} profile.
errors.badHandle: That doesn't look like a {network} handle.
errors.badArtist: That doesn't look like a {network} artist link.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: Your hours and every appointment time are in this zone. Change it only if you've actually moved — existing bookings keep their exact time.
timezone.label: Time zone

booking.title: Booking rules
booking.description: How and when clients can book you. Individual services can override notice and approval.

mode.title: Confirmation
mode.description: You can still require approval for specific services in the service editor.
mode.instantDescription: Clients pick a free time and they're booked. Best for most businesses — it's what clients expect.
mode.requestDescription: Clients send a request; you accept or decline. Unanswered requests expire automatically so nobody waits forever.

window.title: When clients can book
window.minNoticeHint: The latest a client can book before a start time.
window.noMinimum: No minimum — book right up to the start
window.advanceHint: How far ahead your calendar opens.
window.daysAhead: {count, plural, one {# day ahead} other {# days ahead}}
window.intervalHint: Shorter intervals give clients more choice; longer ones keep your day tidy.
window.anyStaffDescription: Shows the most open times and spreads bookings across your team. Turn off if clients must choose a person.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Sent by email before each appointment. Clients who book closer than a reminder's time don't get that one.
reminders.descriptionSms: Sent by email and text message (if the client allows texts) before each appointment. Clients who book closer than a reminder's time don't get that one.
reminders.none: No reminders. Clients only get their booking confirmation.
reminders.minutesBefore: {count, plural, one {# minute before} other {# minutes before}}
reminders.hoursBefore: {count, plural, one {# hour before} other {# hours before}}
reminders.daysBefore: {count, plural, one {# day before} other {# days before}}

policies.title: Cancellations & fees
policies.description: Clients see these before they book and again before they cancel.

cancel.title: Cancelling and rescheduling
cancel.hoursBefore: {count, plural, one {# hour before} other {# hours before}}
cancel.daysBefore: {count, plural, one {# day before} other {# days before}}
cancel.lateFeeHintPaid: Kept from what the client paid online. We never charge more than they've paid.
cancel.lateFeeHintUnpaid: Only applies to money paid online. Connect payments and take deposits to enforce it.
cancel.noShowHint: Part of your policy so clients know up front. When you mark a no-show, anything they paid online stays with you; a fee collected in person can be recorded on the appointment.
cancel.refundDepositsDescription: Off means deposits are kept whenever a client cancels.

words.title: In your own words
words.description: Optional notes shown with your policy.
words.lateHint: e.g. “After 15 minutes late we may need to shorten or rebook your service.”
words.beforeHint: Shown to every client before they confirm — directions, what to bring, how to prepare.

tax.title: Sales tax
tax.description: Added on top of your prices at checkout and shown as its own line. Leave at 0 if your prices already include tax.
tax.label: Label

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Take deposits or full payment when clients book. Paying in person always works too.

online.title: Online payments
online.description: Payments are processed by Stripe and paid out to your bank account. Kept never sees card numbers.

unavailable.body: Card payments aren’t switched on for Kept yet. Until they are, clients pay you at the appointment, and you can record each payment — cash, card reader or transfer — from the appointment page so your records and Insights stay accurate.
unavailable.note: Nothing to do here for now. Deposits and policies you set will start applying once online payments open.

none.deposits: Require a deposit or full payment per service
none.fees: Keep late-cancellation fees from deposits automatically
none.tips: Let clients add a tip after the visit
none.time: Takes about 5 minutes. You’ll need your bank details and an ID.

incomplete.body: Stripe still needs a few details before you can take payments.

connected.body: You can take deposits and payments online.
connected.services: Choose what to collect for each service in <link>Services</link>.

link.title: Booking link
link.description: Your page on Kept. Put it in your bio, on your card, on the mirror.

status.liveDescription: Clients can find you in search and book online.
status.draftDescription: Only you can see it. Go live when the checklist is done.

toasts.live: You're live — clients can find and book you
toasts.slugUpdatedDescription: Your old link no longer works — update it wherever you've shared it.

share.title: Share
share.qrHint: Print it at the front desk, on business cards or your mirror. Scanning opens your booking page directly.
share.embedSummary: Add a “Book now” button to your website
share.embedHint: Paste this where you want the button.

slug.title: Web address
slug.description: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Changing it breaks links you've already shared.
slug.label: Address

hideDialog.title: Hide your page?
hideDialog.description: You'll disappear from search and nobody can book online. Existing appointments stay as they are. You can go live again any time.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Where clients book you: your shop, the area you travel to, or online. Each service and team member can be limited to some of them.

privacy.title: What clients can see
privacy.atPlaceBody: The full address and a map, so clients can find you.
privacy.travelBody: Only your city and how far you travel. If you work from home, your home address and exact pin are never shown — search places you within about 5 km. Clients give you their address when they book.
privacy.onlineBody: No address at all, just that sessions happen online.

list.title: Your locations
list.emptyBody: Clients can't book until they know where the appointment happens. Add your shop, the area you travel to, or online sessions.
list.upcoming: {count, plural, one {# upcoming appointment} other {# upcoming appointments}}
list.atLimit: {count, plural, one {Your {plan} plan includes # location. Remove one to add another.} other {Your {plan} plan includes # locations. Remove one to add another.}}
list.primaryHint: The primary location is the one shown first on your profile and in search.

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.description: Clients won't be able to book it any more. Past appointments keep their details.
remove.primaryNote: Your oldest remaining location becomes primary.
remove.membersNote: {count, plural, one {# team member is assigned here. Anyone assigned only here will be bookable at all your locations.} other {# team members are assigned here. Anyone assigned only here will be bookable at all your locations.}}
remove.servicesNote: Services offered here keep their other locations.
remove.onlyLocation: It's your only location. Add another one first so clients still have somewhere to book.
remove.upcoming: {count, plural, one {It has # upcoming appointment. Move or cancel it from your <link>calendar</link> first.} other {It has # upcoming appointments. Move or cancel them from your <link>calendar</link> first.}}
remove.exclusive: {count, plural, one {{names} is only offered here. Offer it somewhere else or hide it in <link>Services</link>.} other {{names} are only offered here. Offer them somewhere else or hide them in <link>Services</link>.}}

dialog.name: Name
dialog.nameHintPhysical: Shown to clients, e.g. the shop's name or neighbourhood.
dialog.nameHintOther: Shown to clients when they choose where to book.
dialog.countryHint: Two letters, e.g. US, MX, ES
dialog.timezoneHint: Hours and bookings here use this zone.
dialog.phoneHint: If clients should call this location directly.
dialog.primaryDescription: Shown first on your profile and used for search.

pin.title: Map pin
pin.physical: Puts your shop on the map and in “near me” searches. Clients see the address you entered above.
pin.mobile: Used only to match you with nearby clients. Your exact pin and street address are never shown — your profile shows the city, and search places you within about 5 km.
pin.notPinned: Not pinned yet. You'll still appear when clients search your city.
pin.noGeolocation: This browser can't share its location.
pin.here: Pinned to where you are now.
pin.denied: We couldn't get your location. Check your browser's location permission.
pin.noMatch: No match found. Check the address, or use your current location.

physical.label: Arrival instructions
physical.placeholder: e.g. Park on Elm St. Ring the buzzer for unit 2B and come up to the second floor.
physical.hint: Parking, entrance, buzzer code. Clients see this on your profile and in their booking.

mobile.label: Notes for clients
mobile.placeholder: e.g. I'll need a parking spot within 50 m and access to a power outlet.
mobile.hint: What clients should have ready. Shown in their booking.

virtual.label: How sessions work
virtual.placeholder: e.g. You'll get a video link by message an hour before your session.
virtual.hint: Shown in their booking. Don't paste a private meeting link here — send links in Messages.

verification.title: Verification
verification.description: Show clients that a real, licensed business is behind your profile. Our team checks the documents you send by hand.

body.notSubmitted: You haven't asked to be verified yet. Send a few details and documents below.
body.pending: Sent on {date}. Someone on our team reviews every request by hand; you'll get a notification as soon as there's a decision. You can't change the request while it's in review.
body.pendingNoDate: Sent. Someone on our team reviews every request by hand; you'll get a notification as soon as there's a decision. You can't change the request while it's in review.
body.verified: {name} is verified since {date}. The badge shows on your <link>public profile</link> and in search results.
body.verifiedNoDate: {name} is verified. The badge shows on your <link>public profile</link> and in search results.
body.rejected: We couldn't verify {name} with what was sent on {date}. You can send new details and documents below.
body.rejectedNoDate: We couldn't verify {name} with what was sent. You can send new details and documents below.
body.needsInfo: Our team needs a bit more before deciding. Answer below and your request goes back into review.

submit.firstDescription: Tell us about the business and attach proof. Most businesses send one licence or registration document.
submit.againDescription: We've kept what you sent last time. Change it or add to it.

sent.title: What you sent
sent.removed: Some documents were removed and can no longer be opened.

meaning.title: What clients see
meaning.checkMark: A check mark next to your name on your profile and in search results, labelled “Verified business”.
meaning.notEndorsement: It means Kept reviewed documents you provided. It isn't a review of your work or an endorsement — your ratings still come from clients.
meaning.private: Documents stay private. Only people who manage this business and Kept's review team can open them.
meaning.removable: Our team can remove the badge later, for example if a licence turns out to be invalid.

form.tooMany: {count, plural, one {You can attach up to # document.} other {You can attach up to # documents.}}
form.needSomething: Add a short description or at least one document.
form.sentReply: Sent. Your request is back in review.
form.hint: Licence or registration numbers, who issued them, and how long you've been working. Anything that helps us confirm the business is real and yours.
form.placeholder: e.g. Licensed barber, NY State licence #12345678, issued 2019. Shop registered as North Fade LLC.
form.documentsHint: Photos or scans (JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 15 MB each) of a licence, registration certificate or certification. Up to {max}.
form.attachedCount: {count, plural, one {# document attached} other {# documents attached}}
form.privacy: Only people who manage this business and Kept's review team can open these files. They're never shown on your profile.

forms.title: Client questions
forms.description: Questions clients answer while they book: allergies, goals, the car they're bringing. Build a form once, then pick it on each service that needs it.
forms.notIncludedBody: Intake questions aren't part of the {plan} plan. Services still take bookings without them.
forms.emptyBody: Ask what you need to know before the appointment, so you're not finding out at the chair. Answers are saved on the booking and shown to whoever does the appointment.
forms.footer: To ask a form on a service, open the service and choose it under Questions & requirements. Each service asks at most one form.
forms.notUsed: Not used by any service yet

short_text.label: Short answer
short_text.hint: A name, a number, a few words.
short_text.placeholder: e.g. What's the make and model of your car?

long_text.label: Paragraph
long_text.placeholder: e.g. Tell us about any injuries we should know about.

yes_no.label: Yes / No
yes_no.placeholder: e.g. Is this your first visit?

single_choice.label: Multiple choice
single_choice.placeholder: e.g. How long is your hair right now?

multi_choice.label: Checkboxes
multi_choice.placeholder: e.g. Which areas would you like us to focus on?

date.label: Date
date.hint: A date picker, e.g. date of birth or event date.

acknowledgement.label: Acknowledgement
acknowledgement.hint: A statement clients tick to confirm they've read it.
acknowledgement.placeholder: e.g. I understand a patch test is needed 48 hours before a colour service.

errors.name: Give the form a name
errors.statement: Write the statement clients agree to
errors.question: Write the question
errors.distinct: Each choice needs to be different

builder.leaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes to this form. Leave without saving them?

toasts.archivedFrom: {count, plural, one {Form archived and removed from # service} other {Form archived and removed from # services}}

builder.nameHint: Only your team sees this. Clients just see the questions.
builder.emptyBody: Keep it short. Two or three questions get answered; ten get skipped.

saveBar.fix: {count, plural, one {Fix # thing before saving} other {Fix # things before saving}}

archiveDialog.title: Archive “{name}”?
archiveDialog.confirmUsed: {count, plural, one {Archive and remove from # service} other {Archive and remove from # services}}
archiveDialog.descriptionUsed: These services will stop asking these questions on new bookings until you choose another form:
archiveDialog.descriptionUnused: No service asks this form, so nothing changes for clients.
archiveDialog.keep: Answers already given on past and upcoming bookings stay on those bookings.
archiveDialog.lost: Unsaved edits to this form will be lost.

usage.none: No service asks this form yet. Open a service in <link>Services</link> and choose it under Questions & requirements.
usage.title: Asked when clients book
usage.note: Changes apply to new bookings for these services as soon as you save.

card.question: Question
card.helpAck: Shown under the statement, e.g. where to read the full policy.
card.ackRequired: Clients can't book until they tick it.

preview.title: Client preview
preview.description: The “A few details” step of booking. Try it; nothing is saved.
preview.empty: Questions you add appear here as clients will see them.
preview.noteHint: Every booking ends with this box. It isn't part of your form.
preview.invalid: {count, plural, one {# answer missing or invalid} other {# answers missing or invalid}}
preview.allGood: All good — this would go through.

appearance.title: Page appearance
appearance.description: Make your public page look like you: its header, accent colour, the order of sections, a notice and your own link buttons.

masthead.title: Header
masthead.body: Dark and cinematic, or light and airy. Your cover photo shows through either way.

accent.title: Accent colour
accent.body: Used for small details: labels, rules, stars and highlights.

sections.title: Sections
sections.body: Choose what visitors see and in which order. Services come first and reviews always stay visible — they are what makes your page trustworthy.

notice.title: Notice
notice.body: A short message at the top of your page — holiday hours, a waitlist, a new location.
notice.label: Message

links.title: Link buttons
links.body: Your menu, gift cards, a shop or a playlist: up to 8 buttons shown on your page.
links.label: Button text
